known_limits: The oracle item text is the seat's rendering of the statement; the counter uses it only to locate the binding (token, span, path), never the seat's holds or evidence fields (the code drops them on load).
H items are checked by digest match against any blob at W, or against the lane's declared probe-verdicts matrix aggregate; the counter does not establish which file the author meant.
Q failures carry a constant observed string (q:no-artifact), so a policy can meet the counter by selecting the right statements; the counter tests selection, not wording.
The population is the union of the extractor and two enumerations; it is not a claim about statements outside both.
